text:
alex: Quick heads-up — scheduling a rolling cutover of dedicated-gpu-pool-7 tonight at 02:00 UTC. Goal: land autoscaler tweak + pool slice bump (slice size -> 16GB) and validate canary traffic. Expected total window ~25m. Will run smoke and perf checks after each slice. @priya you OK to own the rollback if anything flares?

priya: yep I can own rollback. what's the canary size?

alex: canary = 5% traffic routed to new slice (pool-7-slice-B). If canary passes for 10m, we roll remaining slices at ~5m intervals. If latency p50 jumps >20% or error rate >0.5% we stop and rollback.

dan: ETA on config? need to review the autoscaler change.

alex: pushing PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/r12345
Diff is tiny — changes target: autoscale.window_ms from 120000 -> 180000 and reduce min_replicas from 2 -> 1 for low-util slices. Also adds explicit eviction_timeout=30s for GPUs.

emily: tagging perf — I'll run the smoke harness. plan: after canary is up, run 1000 short-gen requests (seq len ~64) and check p50/p95/p99 + token-srv CPU. Command I'll run: 

```
# smoke script (local)
./scripts/smoke_pool.sh --pool pool-7 --slice pool-7-slice-B --concurrency 20 --requests 1000
```

Then curl metrics endpoint: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/pool/pool-7 | jq .`

lz: quick note — make sure the KV cache warmup is enabled for the new slice (we had cold-start noise last time). Add env `KV_WARMUP=true` on the slice config.

alex: good catch, I'll add that env var to the slice template in the PR.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by alex for 02:00 UTC. Steps: create slice B, apply autoscaler config, route 5% canary. Automated smoke triggers disabled — manual triggers from perf are expected.

priya: when do you want the on-call rotation? I can be primary, dan can be backup.

dan: backup ok for me 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll keep phone on.

emily: after the canary passes I'll also run the burst test (200 concurrent requests for 60s) — looking for request queueing. If queue depth > 10 for >30s we abort.

alex: Rollback plan (short):
1) Re-route canary traffic back to slice-A (pool-7-slice-A).
2) Revert autoscaler change (roll config PR back to previous commit).
3) If nodes allocated, drain and return GPUs to pool.
4) Open incident channel if we see client-visible errors.

priya: added the rollback checklist to the runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/pool-rollbacks#pool-7

lz: FYI I'm pre-warming a set of demo models on slice-B to reduce first-token latency spikes.

alex: timing sync — I'll start the cut at 02:00, create slice within first 3m, route canary by 02:05, start perf smoke at 02:07. If green by 02:17 we continue progressive roll for the rest of the pool, finishing ~02:40. If anything bad we stop and rollback (priya executes).

emily: copy. I'll post results in thread with brief metrics summary.

dan: noted. I'll watch infra alerts and be ready to flip traffic.

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window will set `maintenance=true` tag on pool-7 which disables non-critical batch jobs.

alex: last sanity note: owners check - infra: dan/lz, perf: emily, rollback: priya, deploy lead: alex. Thanks all — I'll ping here when I kick off. :rocket:
